name: Glitchers
storyline:
Ruled Earth is a classic high-fantasy world where wise guardians guide fearless heroes and heroines in the fight against merciless creatures. At least, that’s how it used to be before bizarre events began to unfold.

Handsome orcs, dwarves who refuse to work, heroes who can’t fight…

Lost in this strange universe, Trix must team up with a brute-force heroine on the brink of death to find the pieces of a legendary armor and defeat a cruel Emperor who seeks to wipe out all the heroes of this doomed land.
summary:
Lost in a strange universe, Trix must team up with a brute-force heroine on the brink of death to find the pieces of a legendary armor and defeat a cruel Emperor who seeks to wipe out all the heroes of the Ruled Earth.

On this journey, Trix faces ruthless enemies in dynamic battles, unleashing powerful strikes and special skills, along with an incredible power—the ability to hack this universe and create epic combos.

In each hack, players combine hacking gems to trigger chain reactions, defeating enemies and solving puzzles along the way.
